body.purpose: Default reading text and most UI copy.

shadows.name: soft-ambient-lift
shadows.purpose: Diffuse lift for shell and cards.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Quick state changes on hover and focus.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink); color: var(--surface); padding: 12px 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease-out, opacity 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-2); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 18%, var(--line)); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-2); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Primary content container for reusable page blocks.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); border-radius: 22px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 24px 80px rgba(20, 17, 15, 0.08); }

components.name: Page Section
components.description: Structural wrapper for headings and grouped content.

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Sticky app shell navigation with clear active state.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 18px; color: var(--muted); } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a.is-active { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview:
This system is meant to feel like a well-kept studio table, practical tools, clear labels, and enough warmth to make the interface feel considered without turning decorative. The palette stays restrained, the layout stays readable, and the component language stays deliberately small so the template remains easy to clone, extend, and maintain.

It explicitly rejects the most common AI template tells: SaaS-gray monotony, glassmorphism as a default effect, repetitive card grids, and overbuilt design systems that add more abstraction than value. The point is not to impress with complexity, it is to make the starting point trustworthy and easy to keep using.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained, commerce-friendly, and readable at a glance.
Warm surface tones with a grounded ink contrast.
Simple component vocabulary that stays reusable.

rules.name: Surface-First Rule
rules.body: The interface earns depth through layered surfaces, not through heavy decoration.

rules.name: Accent-Rarity Rule
rules.body: Accent color should feel intentional and sparse. If everything is emphasized, nothing is.

rules.name: Readable-First Rule
rules.body: If type needs special styling to be understood, it is too decorative for this template.

rules.name: Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Elevation supports structure. It never becomes the headline.

dos: Do keep the visual hierarchy simple and readable on first load.
Do use the shared card, button, and section primitives as the base for new pages.
Do preserve the warm surface palette and strong ink contrast.
Do keep the app shell lightweight so new routes are easy to add.
Do use subtle state changes instead of decorative motion.
donts: Don't use SaaS-gray defaults that make the template feel generic.
Don't lean on glassmorphism as a default effect.
Don't build identical card grids just to fill space.
Don't over-round cards or inputs until they feel cartoonish.
Don't introduce extra abstraction layers unless reuse is already real.
Don't make dark mode the default aesthetic.
